subject: 70 dials, zero answers? Let email pick who you call
previewText: Unknown-number fatigue and spam labels are hurting your connect rate. Here's the fix.

featuredArticle.title: 70 Dials a Day and Nobody Answers: Let Email Decide Who You Call
featuredArticle.spotlight: When aged leads stop picking up, the usual advice is more dials at better times. The real culprits are unknown-number fatigue and a spam label on your own phone. This piece shows you how to check your number, how to let email decide who deserves a call, and how to build a shorter, calmer work week around it. It also covers the texting and compliance questions, so you don't have to guess.

quickTips: Track conversations per 100 dials, per number, every week
Send an email that asks one question a reader can answer in a few words
Sort Monday's list by what each lead did with your email
industryInsight: Most people no longer answer a number they don't know
